figures.finding: The Film Fund Luxembourg grants selective aid (AFS) by committee sessions, scaled to spend in Luxembourg's audiovisual economy: in July 2026 it backed 26 projects, e.g. EUR 3,000,000 (60%) of a EUR 5,000,000 Luxembourg-Irish feature and EUR 1,250,000 (26.53%) of a EUR 4.7 million feature; writing and development awards were EUR 30,000 to 60,000. A 2025 bill would give the Fund EUR 180 million over four years.

figures.finding: Luxembourg has no automatic tax credit for audiovisual production: its producers of animation asked in 2025 for one to be introduced alongside the selective aid.
figures.applies: Luxembourg, as of the producers' opinion on bill 8566.
